name: Kozel
description: Kozel, the domino game of the goat, against computer players in a panel, to play while Claude works: you and your partner against two others with the double-six set, first pair to 101. It pauses when a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session.
author: Oleg Bronzov
